step: # The steps a migration must be able to PROVE it ran, by the run-log lines they
# and reports, per row: present (IDENTISCH), absent-and-required (DIVERGIERT),
# or absent-and-conditional (NICHT PRÜFBAR — the condition is a human call).
# WHY A MANIFEST AT ALL. A step that did not run leaves NO trace anywhere: the
# target tree looks the same as if the step had run and found nothing to do, the
# build is green either way, and the report — written from the log — simply has
# no paragraph about it. Nothing else in this skill can distinguish "ran, found
# nothing" from "never ran". This file is the list of things whose ABSENCE is
#   step        the spec section, exactly as the run-log STEP field carries it
#   action      the stable kebab-case ACTION slug (this is what is matched)
#   shape       both | A | B — the source shape the step applies to
#   condition   always | a named precondition, in which case a missing line is
#               reported NICHT PRÜFBAR: only a human knows whether it held
#   why_it_matters  what goes undetected when this step silently does not run
# Hand-editable on purpose, like `fhir-ig-analysis`' mandatory_pages list. A
# migration that legitimately adds or renames a step edits this file in the same
# change — and says so in its report.

why_it_matters: The Gate-0 measurement of the unmigrated source (spec §9c); every downstream count reconciles against it.
Every shape-B-only row below is skipped when the shape is unknown, so an unrecorded shape silently disables half of this manifest.
The pinned SUSHI/goFSH versions are the run's only record of what produced its output.
The inventory is what goFSH's and the harvest's counts are reconciled against; without it every count is self-reported.
Identity carried over unread is identity invented.
The published package is the only machine source for the dependency PINS (spec §2.1.1).
The repository's LICENSE text is the only machine source for `license` — the field that must never default (spec §2.2).
Without the discovery chain the guide is not found, and a migration then ships the template's starter pages.

condition: the narrative is not in the repository
why_it_matters: This is the step whose absence shipped the template's starter pages under a module's name.
The input count, taken BY CONTENT, is the number goFSH's own counts are reconciled against.
goFSH exits 0 having converted 1 of 20 inputs when `-t json-and-xml` is missing; only this line's counts show it.
The "41" of 41 → 5: without the baseline the repair's effect is unmeasurable.
The two mechanical repairs; a parse error otherwise TRUNCATES a file while SUSHI still exports the instance.
The "5": the residual, which must be named unresolvable parents and nothing else.

condition: a parent package ships no snapshots
why_it_matters: A hand-rolled snapshot fabricates a parent; the detect run is what proves none was needed.
Records the template ref and commit the skeleton came from — the provenance check (P2) reads it from here.
The skeleton must compile before any artefact is transferred, or the first error is unattributable.
The step that moves the module's own content; silence here is a migration that moved nothing.
An unconverted Simplifier/FQL directive renders as nothing at all.

The seven OPTIONAL (0..1) pages must each be decided — keep (banner + marker deleted, both languages) or remove per the template's procedure (spec §9a); the template's M9 fails a module release while undecided, and a migration with no line here silently shipped seven "decide me" banners.

Stage 3 of security-and-privacy: module aspects written or the default text adopted, and the scaffold's Person example + ILLUSTRATIVE-EXAMPLE marker deleted in both languages (spec §9a); the template's M11 fails a release branch while it is present.

The advice run that WRITES migration-log/page-map.tsv (page-structure-advice.py --map, spec §9e/§9f) — one generated line per SOURCE PAGE naming the branch taken and the measurement that forced it, plus the coverage summary. Its absence means the routing never ran: the map that step 5 consumes and C3/C6 check against was then either never generated or written by hand, and hand-routing by judgement is exactly what §9e exists to prevent — a page invented to hold one artefact's text, a menu grown past two levels and a 4000-word merged host page all look like deliberate design without this line.

Writes migration-log/derived-content.tsv, the ledger the verifier's C7 reads. With no line here the text the migration WROTE is indistinguishable from the text it carried: C4 finds no loss, C6 finds no misplacement, the build is green, and a Gate-B reviewer reads invented prose as if the module's authors had signed it. C7 can then only report NICHT PRÜFBAR.
Page titles fall back to the default language with no error anywhere.
One of the two numbers this migration exists to produce.
The other one — and the rendered output every provenance and rendering check reads.
Its absence is how the same-module verification gets quietly skipped rather than escalated.

The pre→post diff of the two ig-stats measurements (spec §5.6). Silence here hides a REGRESSION behind a green build — an artefact count that dropped, a licence that turned contradictory, an injected dependency, an identity field that changed: nothing else compares the migrated tree against the Gate-0 measurement, so a migration that lost content would otherwise report only its successes.
The verification phase itself. A migration reported as verified with no line here was not.
